title: Funding Readiness
description: Machine-readable funding readiness assessment for a venture. Scores 0-100 across 12 dimensions, plus funding-specific data.

venture_id.description: Reference to the venture this readiness assessment belongs to

assessor.description: Agent, human, or system that performed the assessment

legal.description: Business identity: legal name, EIN, formation docs, licenses, registrations, ownership structure, beneficial ownership, NAICS/SIC

banking.description: Banking & financial infrastructure: business bank account, merchant account, payment processor, accounting system

accounting.description: Accounting: bookkeeping, bank statements, credit-card history, AR/AP, cash-flow records, balance sheet, P&L, cash-flow statement

credit.description: Credit: business credit profile (D&B, Experian Business, Equifax Business), trade references, vendor accounts, Net-30, business credit cards, debt-to-income, existing debt schedule

revenue.description: Revenue: current revenue, MRR, ARR, revenue history, revenue concentration, customer count, ACV, gross margin, EBITDA, revenue growth, AR aging, signed contracts, purchase orders

documentation.description: Documentation completeness: loan/grant/investor applications, funding memorandum, cap table, ownership breakdown, debt schedule, personal financial statement, tax returns, financial projections, supporting contracts

business_plan.description: Business plan: executive summary, problem, solution, target market, competitive analysis, business model, pricing, go-to-market, operations plan, management team, financial projections, use of funds, repayment/exit strategy

collateral.description: Collateral & risk: equipment, vehicles, real estate, inventory, AR, IP, securities, personal guarantees, insurance, business continuity plan, risk assessment

investor_readiness.description: Investor readiness: pitch deck, investment thesis, market size (TAM/SAM/SOM), traction, product, competitive moat, CAC, LTV, retention, growth metrics, cap table, valuation, data room

grant_readiness.description: Grant readiness: eligibility (geographic, industry, entity), project description, community/economic impact, budget, timeline, matching funds, financial documentation, organizational capacity, reporting plan, certifications

sba_bank_readiness.description: SBA/bank readiness: business registration, EIN, good standing, bank account, financial statements, tax returns, debt schedule, business plan, personal financial statement, credit history, collateral info, loan purpose, cash-flow projections, repayment ability

alternative_funding.description: Alternative funding readiness: revenue-based financing, equipment financing, PO financing, invoice factoring, asset-based lending, business credit cards, vendor financing, crowdfunding, angel/VC/strategic investment readiness

overall.description: Average of all 12 dimensions, weighted equally

funding_status.description: Overall funding readiness status derived from the overall score

funding_gaps.description: Specific gaps that prevent funding at each level

fundable_at.description: At what funding level is this venture currently fundable?

large.description: $500K-$2M (SBA 7(a)/504, VC, strategic investment, bank term loan)

funding_sources_eligible.description: Funding sources this venture qualifies for based on readiness
